toggle_state_properties.0x10001D4C: Power Attack toggle state (discovered via API on 0x79000355)
toggle_state_properties.0x10001D50: Combat Expertise toggle state (discovered via API on 0x79000355)

property_on_action.name: Action_Action_m_eTogglePropertyName
property_on_action.description: On any ability's DbProperties entry, this UInt32 property points to the runtime InstanceProperty that tracks the toggle ON/OFF state

is_toggle_flag.name: Action_Action_m_bIsToggle
is_toggle_flag.description: Byte flag on an ability's DbProperties entry: 0x01 = this ability IS a toggle, 0x00 = not a toggle

cooldown_timer_dids.Action_Action_m_eCooldownTimer1: 0x10001DCA (value on ability = the DID of the timer property)

how_to_discover_a_toggle_property.step_1: Search the API by name to find the ability's DbProperties ID: GET /DbProperties/IdsForName?name=MyToggle
how_to_discover_a_toggle_property.step_3: Look for property with ID 0x10001D47 (Action_Action_m_eTogglePropertyName) - its value is the toggle state property DID
how_to_discover_a_toggle_property.step_4: Use that DID in the plugin's ToggleStatePropertyDid field
how_to_discover_a_toggle_property.note: Toggle state properties are Byte type. Value 1 = ON, Value 0 = OFF
